capabilities: Run code blocks with streaming live output, input prompts and a stop button
Edit code files with syntax highlighting, line numbers and run shortcuts
View Jupyter notebooks read-only with saved outputs
Render HTML blocks and files in a sandboxed preview
Share vault folders with local AI agents through an MCP bridge with reviewable change proposals
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes detailed safety disclosures (filesystem, shell, clipboard, network) and performance measurements. It was renamed from Obsidian Coder (coder-studio) and imports old settings on first start.
intentEvidence: Execute Code is the most-used plugin for running code blocks. Brief Coder covers the same ground with a different focus
problem: Obsidian renders code blocks as static text and offers no way to execute them or edit code files inside the vault.
